title: 第44章 军中鬼见愁，狗见狗摇头
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 何镇涛提着空饭盒离开了。临走前叮嘱陆阳好好休息别乱跑。他得回老单位办点事，下午就不来了。留下陆阳一个人躺在病床上，看着天花板发呆。果然，人在饿的时候只想一件事，那就是吃饭。填饱肚子以后，脑袋里各种乱七八糟的事就来了。平心而论，作为班长，陆阳觉得周凯东是合格的。不论是泄密事件发生后，周凯东一个劲儿的把罪责往身上揽；还是丁腾飞被食堂“冤枉”偷东西，他第一时间选择站在自已的兵这边。这都很好的诠释，周凯东称得上是一个称职的好班长。但也正是因为过分的称职，把他给牢牢困在里头。金无足赤，人无完人。陆阳不希望因为这么点儿小事，导致周凯东被撤掉。新兵连不仅是训练新兵的地方，同样也是对老兵们带兵能力的一次综合检验。如果周凯东被撤，等同于严重带兵事故，未来别说评优评选，想要继续留队都困难。如果这件事发生在别的班也就罢了，既然出现在身边那他就不能坐视不理。毕竟，谁又能保证周凯东走了以后，换来的人就比他更称职？如果是个像四班长那样，喜欢投机取巧；或是像一班长那样，不带脏字不会说话的咋办？想到这，陆阳干脆从床上坐起，穿上衣服后来到门口。悄悄把门打开一条缝，冲着外头走廊看了一眼。候诊室和药房在隔壁，这会儿门都是关着的。陆阳蹑手蹑脚的往外走，想找个小卖部打个电话回新兵连，提前和周凯东通个气。这样一来，明天指导员找到班上新兵问话，也能尽量统一口径，不会被打的措手不及。可人生地不熟的，陆阳根本不知道要往哪里走？来到外头，阳光格外明媚，晃的他有些睁不开眼。和昨天阴云密布，雷声隆隆的鬼天气天壤之别。但冷空气，依旧冻得陆阳缩了缩脖子，不由得绷紧身体。映入眼帘的是一栋十多层楼高，气派非凡的办公大楼。楼前是一大片空地，这会儿人来人往的，时不时还有军绿色的吉普车开过。这里的军人肩膀上几乎都是星星，连士官都很少见。大多表情严肃神色匆匆，拿着文件夹或是提着公文包，像是很赶时间的样子。部队是个说话做事雷厉风行的地方，即便是机关单位也不例外。果然，人还是得多出来见见世面。没离开新兵连之前，除了那位莅临检查的团副正委，连长和指导员是陆阳见过最大的官。可来了这么，陆阳才发现原来，军官在团部就像是大白菜一样稀疏平常。这时，陆阳的注意力被广场正前方的一座极具视觉冲击力的大雕像吸引。那是一只手，准确的说是从雪堆里伸出的一只大手，手里还紧紧握着一把长枪。雕塑底座，苍劲有力的写着特三团三个大字。底下一行小字写着：原志愿军第十七师302团。因为先前是夜里来的，又发着烧，所以陆阳当时并没有注意到这座雕塑，没想到白天看竟是如此震撼。不愧是拥有悠久历史背景，立下过赫赫战功的光荣部队，光是从这尊雕塑反映出的动态，就能看到曾经雪山上那段被战火和鲜血染红的历史。“干什么的？”陆阳正看得入神，后头突然走来一名持枪卫兵，冷冷喊了他一声。陆阳见对方手里拿着枪，还一脸严肃的盯着自已，连忙解释是来团部医务室挂水的新兵。卫兵皱眉：“那你为什么不在医务室病床上躺着，这里不是你能随便乱走的地方！”陆阳：“我想找地方打个电话，但不知道军人服务社在哪儿？”卫兵上下打量陆阳，见他面色苍白，病殃殃的模样不疑有他。昨个夜里，确实有上尉带着个新兵通过门岗，说是带来挂水的，想来就是他了。卫兵问清原由后并未刁难，而是主动带路指引他军人服务社的位置。路上，经过长长的林荫道，两旁的仓房里，停靠着一排排正在保养的战车。叮叮当当的敲打声响个不停，近距离看到这么多钢铁巨兽，陆阳也不由得心跳加速。他在想，坦克炮弹的威力有多大，一炮弹下去能不能将新兵连后头的小土山炸平了？如果不是有卫兵跟着，他都想凑上去摸两把，甚至是打开舱盖进到驾驶舱里，瞅瞅里头究竟长啥样，顺带看看孔垄那体格子到底能不能塞进去？“前面走到头，转过去就是了。”“打完电话就赶紧回医务室，这里是团部重地，不允许随便乱跑。”“也就是碰上的我们好说话，要是遇上执勤的白乌龟，保你吃不了兜着走。”“白乌龟？”陆阳愣了愣，卫兵却笑了，说你碰上就知道了。卫兵转身离开，系统也在这时做出科普。陆阳这才明白白乌龟，白王八，白帽子，白狗这些难听词汇都是形容一个岗位的。纠察。全程，警备纠察。他们的制服与常规军装有很大不同，通常戴着印有“警备纠察”字样的白色头盔，戴白色手套。再加上执勤时更多得靠两条腿来回走动，不如机动单位那般迅速，所以被戏称为白乌龟。纠察多为两人一组，一个手持相机，另一人夹着本子。经常在营区各个地方神出鬼没，专门处罚违规违纪的军人。不论是头发过长，鞋带没塞进鞋里，风纪扣没系上，还是边走路边吃东西，都在他们的处罚范围内。陆阳这种肩膀上连个肩章都没有的三无人员，一个人在营区里晃荡，左顾右盼的到处张望，自然是不合规矩的。也正是因为岗位的特殊性质，再加上纠察本身有绩效考核，罚不到指定数量他们就得挨批评。所以，部队从上到下都很不待见那帮人，瞧见了就跟碰上瘟神似的。更有人给编了一首打油诗：军中鬼见愁，狗见狗摇头。据说，纠察退伍和普通士兵退伍时间不同，得提前走。否则容易被战友热情送温暖，也不知道真的假的？陆阳还没见过纠察，也没遇到过，也不想遇到。他可不想被挑点儿毛病出来，然后被通知班长连长，过来把自已领走。忽然，陆阳眼前一亮，目光落在不远处......
content_en: He Zhentao left with the empty lunch box.Before leaving, he told Lu Yang to have a good rest and not run around.He has to go back to his old workplace to do some errands and won't be coming in the afternoon.Lu Yang was left lying alone on the hospital bed, staring at the ceiling in a daze.Sure enough, when people are hungry, they only want to do one thing, and that is to eat.After filling my stomach, all kinds of messy things come to mind.To be fair, as a squad leader, Lu Yang felt that Zhou Kaidong was qualified.Whether it was after the leak, Zhou Kaidong continued to take the blame on himself; or Ding Tengfei was "unjustly accused" of stealing from the canteen, he immediately chose to side with his soldiers.This is a good explanation. Zhou Kaidong can be regarded as a good and competent monitor.But it was precisely because of his excessive competence that he was trapped inside.No gold is pure, and no man is perfect.Lu Yang didn't want Zhou Kaidong to be removed because of such a trivial matter.The recruit company is not only a place to train new recruits, but also a comprehensive test of the veterans' ability to lead troops.If Zhou Kaidong is withdrawn, it will be equivalent to a serious military accident. In the future, it will be difficult to stay in the team, let alone the merit selection.It would be fine if this happened in another class, but since it happened around him, he couldn't just sit idly by and ignore it.After all, who can guarantee that after Zhou Kaidong leaves, the person he replaces will be more competent than him?What if you are like the Fourth Squad Leader, who likes to take advantage of others? Or what if you are like the First Squad Leader, who cannot speak without using curse words?Thinking of this, Lu Yang simply sat up from the bed, put on his clothes and came to the door.He quietly opened the door a crack and took a look at the corridor outside.The waiting room and pharmacy are next door, and the doors are closed at the moment.Lu Yang tiptoed out, hoping to find a canteen to call back to the recruit company and talk to Zhou Kaidong in advance.In this way, when the instructor asks the new recruits in the class tomorrow, he can try to have the same tone and not be caught off guard.But being unfamiliar with this place, Lu Yang didn't know where to go?When he came outside, the sun was particularly bright, making him unable to open his eyes.It was a far cry from yesterday's spooky weather with clouds and thunder.But the cold air still made Lu Yang shrink his neck and tighten his body.What comes into view is an extraordinary office building with a height of more than ten floors.There is a large open space in front of the building. People are coming and going, and military green jeeps drive by from time to time.The soldiers here almost have stars on their shoulders, and even non-commissioned officers are rare.Most of them had serious expressions and were in a hurry, holding folders or briefcases, as if they were in a hurry.The army is a place where people speak and act resolutely, even in government agencies.Sure enough, people still have to go out and see the world.Before leaving the recruit company, the company commander and instructor were the biggest officials Lu Yang had ever seen, except for the deputy regimental committee member who came for inspection.But after arriving here, Lu Yang realized that officers were as sparse and ordinary as cabbage in the regiment headquarters.At this time, Lu Yang's attention was attracted by a large statue with great visual impact right in front of the square.It was a hand, to be precise, a big hand stretched out from the snowdrift, holding a long gun tightly in its hand.On the base of the sculpture, the three characters "Tesan Tuan" are written vigorously and forcefully.A line of small characters at the bottom reads: Former 302nd Regiment of the 17th Division of the Volunteer Army.Because he came at night and had a fever, Lu Yang didn't notice the sculpture at the time. He didn't expect it to be so shocking when seen in the daytime.It is indeed a glorious unit with a long historical background and outstanding military exploits. Just from the dynamics reflected in this sculpture, you can see the history of the snow-capped mountains that was stained red by war and blood."What are you doing?" Lu Yang was watching intently when a guard with a gun suddenly came up from behind and called him coldly.Lu Yang saw that the other party had a gun in his hand and was staring at him seriously, so he quickly explained that he was a new recruit who came to the regimental infirmary to hang out.The guard frowned: "Then why don't you lie down on the bed in the infirmary. This is not a place where you can wander around!" Lu Yang: "I want to find a place to make a call, but I don't know where the military service agency is?" The guard looked Lu Yang up and down, and saw that he looked pale and sick, and there was no doubt that he was there.Last night, a captain did pass the gate with a new soldier, saying he was bringing water for hanging. I think it was him.After the guard asked him the reason, he did not make things difficult, but took the initiative to lead him to the location of the Military Service Club.On the road, passing through a long tree-lined avenue, rows of chariots being maintained were parked in the warehouses on both sides.The sound of clanging and banging was endless. Seeing so many giant steel beasts at close range, Lu Yang couldn't help but feel his heart beat faster.He was thinking about how powerful the tank shells were. Could one shell flatten the small hill behind the recruit company?If there weren't guards following him, he would have wanted to go up and touch a few of them, or even open the hatch cover and enter the cockpit to see what it looked like inside, and by the way, whether Kong Long's body grid could be stuffed into it?"Just walk to the end and turn around." "After making the call, hurry back to the infirmary. This is the headquarters of the regiment. You are not allowed to run around casually." "It means we are easy to talk to. If you meet a white turtle on duty, I guarantee you won't be able to eat and walk around." "White turtle?" Lu Yang was stunned, but the guard smiled and said that you will know when you meet him.The guard turned and left, and the system also made a popular science statement at this time.Only then did Lu Yang understand that these ugly words like white turtle, white tortoise, white hat, and white dog all describe the same position.picket.The whole process was guarded and guarded.Their uniforms are very different from regular military uniforms, usually wearing white helmets with the words "Picket" printed on them and white gloves.In addition, when on duty, they have to move back and forth on two legs and are not as fast as mobile units, so they are nicknamed the white turtle.The pickets are usually in groups of two, one holding a camera and the other holding a notebook.He often appears in various places in the camp, specifically punishing soldiers who violate laws and disciplines.Whether it is hair that is too long, shoelaces that are not tucked into shoes, style buckles that are not fastened, or eating while walking, they are all within the scope of their punishment.It was naturally against the rules for a Sanwu officer like Lu Yang, who didn't even have an epaulette on his shoulders, to wander around the camp alone and look around.It is precisely because of the special nature of the position and the fact that picketing itself has performance appraisals that they have to be criticized if they do not receive the specified amount of punishment.Therefore, from top to bottom, the army did not like to see those people, and it was like encountering the plague.Someone even made up a limerick: The ghosts in the army are sad when they see them, and the dogs shake their heads when they see them.It is said that the discharge time for pickets is different from that for ordinary soldiers, so you have to leave early.Otherwise, it is easy to be warmly received by comrades, and you don’t know whether it is true or false?Lu Yang has never seen a picket, nor has he encountered one, nor does he want to encounter one.He didn't want to have some faults picked out, and then be informed of the squad leader and company commander to come and take him away.Suddenly, Lu Yang's eyes lit up and his eyes fell on something not far away...
